description: Hand-written question set. Every expected fact was checked against the text of the arXiv version named in `paper`. Facts are short exact strings; a retrieved chunk counts as relevant when it contains one.

questions.question: To what value does BERT push the GLUE score?
What MultiNLI accuracy does BERT report?
What Test F1 does BERT reach on SQuAD v1.1 and on SQuAD v2.0?
How many parameters do the BASE and LARGE models have?
What share of WordPiece tokens is masked for the masked language model?
How often is a chosen token replaced with the [MASK] token?
How large is the WordPiece vocabulary?
How many words are in BooksCorpus and in English Wikipedia?
For how many steps is BERT pre-trained?
What batch size is used for pre-training?
What learning rate does Adam use during pre-training?
How long did each pre-training run take?
On how many Cloud TPUs was the LARGE model trained?
Which activation function is used instead of the standard relu?
What BLEU score does BERT achieve on WMT 2014 English-to-German translation?
What top-5 error does BERT achieve on the ImageNet test set?
What learning rate does the RoBERTa baseline use?
